posts.title: Paper Explainer: Dark Radiation Sticks Together: Dark QCD and the Hubble Tension
posts.description: This is an explainer for my new paper "Dark Radiation Sticks Together: Dark QCD and the Hubble Tension" with Rutgers postdocs Nico Fernandez and Eric Putney. In this paper, we propose a model of dark matter that has self-interactions (creating a "dark sector" of physics) which are similar to the physics we see in quantum chromodynamics (QCD). posts.title: The Dumbest Thing I've Read This Week II: Space Mirrors
posts.description: Mirrors in space are a dumb idea. Put that aside for a second. I want to talk about math, and how physicists use math.
